SELECT talent_profiles.talent_id, talent_profiles.user_id, talent_profiles.display_name, talent_profiles.discipline_group, talent_profiles.education, talent_profiles.courses, talent_profiles.research_experience, talent_profiles.research_outputs, talent_profiles.revision, talent_profiles.confirmation_status, talent_profiles.confirmed_revision, talent_profiles.confirmed_at, talent_profiles.updated_at 
FROM talent_profiles JOIN privacy_settings ON talent_profiles.talent_id = privacy_settings.talent_id JOIN users ON users.id = talent_profiles.user_id 
WHERE privacy_settings.discoverable IS 1 AND talent_profiles.confirmation_status = ? AND talent_profiles.confirmed_revision = talent_profiles.revision AND users.role = ? AND users.active IS 1 ORDER BY talent_profiles.talent_id
